qa: Yes, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: This card is also treated as [Sparrowmon] for DigiXros. [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait among them to the hand. Trash the rest. [On Deletion] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] This Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait gains ＜Collision＞.
